title: Italian Steak Tartare
description: A classic Italian dish made with freshly ground steak, perfect for a dinner or snack.
instructions: Grind the steak in a meat grinder or food processor until it reaches a coarse texture.
Transfer the ground steak to a bowl and mix in the tartare to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, season the steak tartare with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh parsley or chives if desired.
